a.lede: Meta’s board feared that its CEO’s departure could disrupt the company’s AI ambitions. A new stock agreement gives him financial incentives to stay put.
a.title: Mark Zuckerberg Agrees to Stay in California Despite Billionaires’ Tax Ballot Measure

b.lede: The Meta boss had said he would exit the state over a wealth tax that has not yet come into force.
b.title: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax
